Förderkriterien.es: criterios de concesión de ayudas (die, plural)

texto: In the framework of collegiate resolutions, consultation tables and institutional opinions, the recommendations are not presented in direct imperative, but by subordinate clauses introduced by proposal verbs (**vorschlagen, anregen, empfehlen, fordern**) followed by **dass**: **Die Kommission empfiehlt, dass die Förderkriterien transparent gestaltet werden** (The Commission recommends that the award criteria be designed with transparency).

The subordinate conjunction **dass** systematically moves the conjugated verb to the last position of the clause. In the contemporary institutional register, the indicative or passive with modal (**gestaltet werden sollen / gestaltet werden müssen**) is usually used after these verbs.
